name: Kingdom of Israel
note: A rough, simplified approximation for orientation only, not a scholarly reconstruction — traced through known anchor points (Dan, Carmel, Joppa, Beersheba, Kadesh-barnea, the Dead Sea, the Arnon, Ramoth-Gilead, Edrei) to exclude the Philistine coast, Ammon, Moab, and Edom while including Gilead and Bashan across the Jordan.

name: Yehud
note: A rough approximation of the small Persian province of Yehud (post-exilic Judah) for orientation only, not a scholarly reconstruction — its precise administrative boundaries aren't fully attested. Traced through a handful of known anchor points (Bethel, the Jordan near Jericho, En Gedi, Beth-zur, Azekah, Gezer) roughly matching standard reconstructions of the province's small extent, well short of the old united kingdom's size.
